title: Agentforce Agents: Conversational AI to Boost Agent Productivity

persona_relevance.why_it_matters: Conversational AI assistants can deflect common queries to self‑service, reduce contact center load, and improve agent productivity and first contact resolution—direct drivers of CSAT and NPS.

action_suggestion: Run a focused Agentforce pilot on a high‑volume queue to track handle time, deflection rates, and CSAT over 30–60 days.
